entry.extractionMethod: YouTube public Innertube Android player captions; srv3 XML normalized locally
entry.scope: Complete event captions retained. Assessment covers formal openings, rebuttals, cross-examination and mutually accepted pre-Q&A discussion only. No separate formal closings occur. All audience Q&A, both speakers’ answers and dependent replies, and the host after-show are excluded at the editor’s request. Six selected audio spans were checked with automatic speech recognition; no direct listening is claimed.
